note: How to read the packed table's source field (来源, the seventh field of each row of data/wardrobe.js in nikkiup2u3) in English. cmd/bundle uses it only for items the wiki has no item page for, and marks every entry it makes "cn":1. codes: each value of the table's own code2src list; a code the table uses for a Global item that is missing here fails the build. signIn: every monthly sign-in code (签到·<n>月). texts: source text that is neither a code nor a story stage (<chapter>-<n>少 or 公, with II-/III- and 支 for side stages, which the build reads itself). dreamWeavers: the Dream Weaver character a ~<name><path> entry names, as the wiki spells it; an empty name means the wiki has no page to confirm it and the line says only Dream Weaver. An event gets its English name only where the wiki names that event on at least three quarters of the items both sources cover, and any other named line only where the wiki gives it on most of them; basis records the count, and cmd/bundle recounts it from the wiki dump and the packed table on every build that reads both and fails on any difference. Umbrella codes (holidays, stamina and spending events, event bundles) stay Limited event, and so do draws the wiki splits between two Global events (抽·沉落之海: 13 Dreamy Sea Voyage, 6 Drowned Kingdom; 抽·云空之境: 4 Brave New World, 3 Cloud Realm).
